messages:
mira: Heads up: rolled int4 per-channel build of nimbus7b-lite to a small canary. Two issues: rougeL down ~2 pts on news-summary evals, and sporadic OOMs on long-context microbatch=8. tagging infra/ML. :wave:

kai: share eval delta + any OOM traces? which kernel path?

mira: rougeL -2.1 vs fp16. p99 latency +12% on >1024 tokens. OOMs ~0.6%. runtime picked 'sparse-attn-simd' with hybrid-kv prefetch. config: quant=int4_perchannel, kernel_policy=sparse-attn-simd, microbatch=8, max_new_tokens=256, prefetch_kv=true.

ashley-sre: pod log snippet: 'cudaMalloc failed: out of memory' stack shows kv_cache reserve during attention with seq_len=1536, total_batch_tokens=12288.

leo-ml: known pattern: some int4 kernels increase transient working set due to tiling; hybrid prefetch + microbatching can spike peak allocations. quality regression likely from small calibration set.

kai: mitigations: (1) reduce defaults.max_new_tokens->128, (2) set prefetch_kv=false, (3) try kernel_policy='dense-fast', (4) redo quant calibration with larger/stratified samples and per-layer clipping. also consider microbatch 8->4 for long seqs.

mira: will push canary patch toggling (1)-(3) to 10% and run larger calibration in parallel. rollout: 10% -> 24h metrics -> 50% if OOM <0.1% and rouge delta <0.5. adding auto-fallback rule: if seq_len>1024 && variant==int4 -> route to int8.

tess-prod: pls ensure rollback/fallback so user-visible summaries aren't degraded.

ashley-sre: infra tasks: pin kernel affinity for canary hosts, add soft cgroup mem threshold to return 429 before node OOM. opening INFRA-6412.

leo-ml: quant job: 5k calibration samples across news/docs/code, per-layer MSE clip, compare top-k logits to fp16.

dev-bot: PR #4127 created by mira -> queued for canary.

mira: deploying now to 10%. will report metrics and samples in ~4-6h. :thumbsup:
